seats.name: single
argv:
Implement format(fmt, ...args) in format.ts according to README.md (keep the export and signature). It must produce exactly the text described there for every format string and argument list the README allows. Use no network or dependencies, and do not shell out to other programs or import a formatting library: the submission is the TypeScript implementation itself. Modify format.ts in this workspace; a chat answer alone is not a submitted implementation. The evaluator runs private tests against your code after completion.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I implemented `format` in `format.ts` with the same export and signature, and a quick spot check gave the expected output. I did not run a full test suite, so the private tests are still untested against it.

The check was one `format` call covering 15 specs: `%.2f` of 2.675, `%.0f` of 0.5 and 2.5, `%g`, `%#g`, `%e`, `%G`, `%#o`, `%#.0o`, zero padding, and `%s` and `%c` padding. Every result matched the README, including `2.67`, `0`, `2`, `1e-05`, `1.50000`, `1.234568e+04` and `-003.142`.

All rounding for `e`, `f` and `g` is done with exact `BigInt` arithmetic on the double's binary value, rounding half to even, as the README requires. It uses no dependencies and no network.

I did not test `-0`, `Infinity`, `NaN`, bigint arguments, very large or subnormal values, or the `+`, space and `#` flags on `x`, `X` and `e`.
